name: Data Analysis
description: Analyze datasets with statistical summaries, trend detection, correlation, and distribution histograms. Accepts a dataset as CSV text, a JSON string, or an array of record objects. No operator credentials required.

dataset.description: Dataset as CSV text, a JSON string (array of objects, or an object with a rows/data/records/items array), or an array of record objects

analysisType.description: Type of analysis to run (default summary)

xColumn.description: Independent variable column for trend analysis (defaults to first date/numeric column)

yColumn.description: Dependent variable column for trend analysis (defaults to first numeric column)

targetColumn.description: Column to describe for distribution analysis (defaults to first numeric column)

topValuesLimit.description: Max top values reported for categorical columns (default 5)

success.description: Whether the analysis completed without error

summary.description: Per-column stats plus optional trend/correlation/distribution results

error.description: Error message, if the analysis failed
